title: Power / economic-buyer coverage

questions.text: Do we understand who can actually approve the decision, and is the proposed action helping us reach that person appropriately?

inputs: recipients and ask of the candidate

criteria.guide: State whether the evidence names who approves the spend; 'unknown' is a finding, not a guess.
Is there a path (champion, process owner) to whoever holds decision authority?

criteria.text: whether the proposed action helps or harms that path
criteria.guide: Does this action move us toward the approver appropriately, or damage the path (e.g. going around the champion)?

har97.text: * whether the proposed action helps or harms that path

criteria.guide: Executive involvement before the working team asks for it is premature.

principles: An unknown economic buyer with spend already approved in writing is a warn; with spend not yet approved it is a fail.

diagnostics.name: no_economic_buyer_access
diagnostics.when: no known approver or no path to them
